content_metadata.description: A comprehensive tutorial providing step-by-step instructions on adding music to video projects using the VideoLeap app, aimed at helping users navigate through the app's interface and enhance their projects with sound.

qAndA.answer: You can only add music that you have purchased or downloaded to your device, ensuring you have the rights to use it.
qAndA.question: What type of music can you add to VideoLeap projects?

qAndA.answer: Tap the "Audio" icon at the bottom of the screen.
qAndA.question: How do you access the music library within VideoLeap?

qAndA.answer: Tap the play button on the sound effect within the "Sound Effects" tab.
qAndA.question: How do you preview sound effects before adding them to the project?

qAndA.answer: Switch from the "Albums" tab to the "Songs" tab in the "Add" menu.
qAndA.question: Where do you find your downloaded music within VideoLeap?

qAndA.answer: VideoLeap offers equalizer, volume control, fade-in/out options, and more, which will be covered in a separate tutorial.
qAndA.question: What additional audio editing features are available in VideoLeap?
